title: Evaluate an essentially constant pro-cone at an initial stage
statement:
Let $J$ be a cofiltered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, $G:J\to\mathcal C$ a functor, and $i\in J$ an initial object, meaning there is a unique morphism $\iota_j:i\to j$ for every $j\in J$. Suppose $G$ is essentially constant as a pro-object with value $X$ [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram] for a specified cone $u_j:X\to G(j)$: these maps are natural in $j$, and there are $j_0\in J$ and $r:G(j_0)\to X$ with $ru_{j_0}=1_X$ such that, for every $j$, some $k\in J$ and arrows $a:k\to j_0$, $b:k\to j$ satisfy $G(b)=u_jrG(a)$. Then $u_i:X\to G(i)$ is an isomorphism whose inverse is
$$w=rG(\iota_{j_0}):G(i)\to X.$$
More precisely, $wu_i=1_X$, $u_iw=1_{G(i)}$, and $u_j=G(\iota_j)u_i$ for every $j$. This assertion holds for the specified cone and every witness $(j_0,r)$ satisfying these conditions.

proof.text: By naturality of the specified cone in [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram], $G(\iota_j)u_i=u_j$ for every $j$. Set $w=rG(\iota_{j_0}):G(i)\to X$. At $j=j_0$, naturality and the given retraction identity yield $wu_i=rG(\iota_{j_0})u_i=ru_{j_0}=1_X$.

source.place: Tag 05PU (categories-definition-essentially-constant-diagram), part (2)(a)-(b); elementary consequence for the specified cone at an initial object, calculated by Q25.

proof.text: Apply the common-stage clause of [def-pc-essentially-constant-pro-diagram] at $j=i$, obtaining $a:k\to j_0$, $b:k\to i$ with $G(b)=u_i rG(a)$. Put $c=\iota_k:i\to k$. Initiality gives $bc=1_i$ and $ac=\iota_{j_0}$, because each is a pair of morphisms from $i$ to the same object. Precompose the factorization with $G(c)$ and use functoriality: $1_{G(i)}=G(bc)=G(b)G(c)=u_i rG(a)G(c)=u_i rG(ac)=u_i rG(\iota_{j_0})=u_iw$.

proof.text: The two identities $wu_i=1_X$ and $u_iw=1_{G(i)}$ say exactly that $u_i$ is an isomorphism with inverse $w$. The formula $u_j=G(\iota_j)u_i$ was proved in Step 1. The calculation began with an arbitrary specified cone and an arbitrary witness $(j_0,r)$ satisfying the stated conditions, so it proves every asserted quantifier.

lean.statement: theorem essentiallyConstantPro_initial_evaluation {J : Type uJ} {C : Type uC} [Category.{vJ} J] [Category.{vC} C] (G : J ⥤ C) (X : C) (i : J) (hi : IsInitial i) (h : IsEssentiallyConstantProDiagram G X) : ∀ (u : (Functor.const J).obj X ⟶ G) (j₀ : J) (r : G.obj j₀ ⟶ X), u.app j₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 X → (∀ j : J, ∃ k : J, ∃ a : k ⟶ j₀, ∃ b : k ⟶ j, G.map b = G.map a ≫ r ≫ u.app j) → IsIso (u.app i) ∧ u.app i ≫ (G.map (hi.to j₀) ≫ r) = 𝟙 X ∧ (G.map (hi.to j₀) ≫ r) ≫ u.app i = 𝟙 (G.obj i) ∧ ∀ j : J, u.app j = u.app i ≫ G.map (hi.to j)
